name: volumio_autodj
description: Continuous play: automatically extends Volumio's play queue with similar tracks from your local library once it's about to run out.
author: Celindir69

volumio_info.details: Watches the play queue and, once it's about to run out, appends a track by an artist similar to what's currently playing (via the Last.fm API), matched against your local library.
volumio_info.changelog: 1.2.0: boundary watcher as a systemd service, only errors in Volumio's log, cleanup after a failed installation.
